name: @bossnyumba/brain-learning
description: Phase N-E — runtime learning + self-improvement substrate. Trace logging, owner-reaction capture, preference-pair builder (DPO/KTO/SimPO), active-learning queue, eval-driven iteration, skill curation, knowledge-graph growth, distilled-student infra, 90-day-cycle tracker. Anthropic does not allow fine-tuning Claude in 2026, so this package ships the runtime layer that works on any model plus the data pipeline feeding self-hosted students.
